scope: One bounded read-only feasibility screen of three official medical multimodal-agent repositories; not an exhaustive survey

candidates.name: MedAgent-Pro
evidence: Case_level.py imports Glaucoma.tools and registers segment_optic_cup/segment_optic_disc; complete nontruncated repository tree contains only Glaucoma/__init__.py, task.json, toolset.json, with no Glaucoma/tools implementation.
Planner.py plan uses openai.ChatCompletion default chatgpt-4o-latest; Case_level.py instantiates API-based coder, analyzer, summarizer and decider.
Decider/Qwen_Decider.py supports local Qwen2.5-VL qualitative analysis, but is not a complete replacement for the released planning/code-generation pipeline.
candidates.assessment: Distinct task-plan/case-execution architecture, but current released example is not executable from the inspected assets. Filling missing domain tools and replacing several agent roles would be a new implementation, not a verified mature native agent under the bounded screen.

candidates.name: MMedAgent
evidence: README requires a specifically trained MMedAgent LoRA and reconstructed LLaVA-Med base from LLaMA plus published delta weights.
The supplied original delta archive alone is listed as 11.06 GB; this is not a measured full installation estimate.
Original serving setup also lists tool-specific checkpoints and workers.
candidates.assessment: Existing generic LLaVA tool checkpoint is not evidence that the required trained planner/base is present. No new-model download is allowed in this screen, so do not substitute generic weights or claim native reproduction.

candidates.name: MMedAgent-Plus
evidence: Agent deployment README explicitly lists planner serving, remaining tool workers and agent loop as future release.
Current tool entrypoints cover only pathology specialists.
candidates.assessment: No mature native full agent release verified; no attempt to fabricate an equivalent agent.

next_action: Keep all closed scientific branches closed; wait for a material availability/authorization change or concrete new evidence. Do not repeat this audit every heartbeat, run GPU retries, buy API access or download weights. HCL remains blocked at base qualification, not disproved.
